name: pwa-preview
description: Deploy and manage temporary HTTPS previews of pre-built static web applications and PWAs.

interface.longDescription: Publish already-built static web applications and PWAs to temporary HTTPS preview URLs. Create, inspect, update, extend, and delete previews without executing application build code.
defaultPrompt: Publish this built static web app as a temporary preview.
Update my existing preview with the latest build.
Show me my active PWA previews.

positive.description: List previews owned by the authenticated user.
positive.prompt: Show me my active PWA Preview deployments.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls preview_list and reports only previews returned for the authenticated user.

positive.description: Inspect one owned preview by ID.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls preview_get for the requested preview ID and reports the returned state without inventing fields.

positive.description: Create a temporary preview from an HTTPS static artifact.
positive.prompt: Create a temporary preview from this static app artifact URL and give me the preview URL.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls preview_create only with the user-provided HTTPS artifact URL, then returns the created preview URL and expiry.

positive.description: Update an existing preview while preserving its preview URL.
positive.prompt: Update preview p-1234567890abcdef from this new static artifact URL.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls preview_update for the existing preview ID and reports the updated preview while preserving the service-returned URL.

positive.description: Delete an owned preview when the user explicitly asks.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls preview_delete only for the requested preview and reports whether deletion succeeded.

negative.description: Do not use PWA Preview to build source code.
negative.prompt: Build this React source repository for me.

negative.description: Do not use PWA Preview to deploy an application backend.
negative.prompt: Deploy this Node API server and database.

negative.description: Do not operate on a preview without an owned preview ID or explicit target.

publication.release_notes: Initial Marketplace package with complete MCP configuration, workflow skill, public support/privacy/terms pages, review cases, and plugin icons.
